ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; no account flag on the driver.

rejected_claims.reason: Presence near the pickup satisfies NS-1(ii) but cannot cure the failed waiting-duration element; the 38-39 m approach and the 21:28:50-21:30:55 stationary period [F1][F3] fall short of the more-than-3-minutes requirement in NS-1(iii) [F2][F5][NS-1].
The 21:29:10 I'm-Here tap [F6] establishes NS-1(i) only; against 1 min 45 s inside the radius after the tap [F6] and 2 min 50 s cumulative [F2], NS-1(iii) still fails [NS-1].
The chat message at 21:29 [F10] shows notice to the rider, not the duration of waiting, and cannot displace the gps/timeline records of 2 min 50 s within 200 m [F2][F5][NS-1].

The clean profile [F17] supports only the absence of an account flag, which is already applied; profile facts cannot defeat the rider's refund entitlement under NS-2, which follows from the timing records [F2][F5][F8][NS-2].
Moot in the rider's favour: no account flag is sought or applied [F17][F6][F1][NS-2]; the driver's record is neither needed for nor capable of defeating the refund.
